name: b-standing-in-the-drained-pool
prompt: Portrait photograph looking down the length of an empty private swimming pool behind a deserted hillside villa. The camera sits low on the dry floor of the shallow end, 28mm lens, eye-line just below the subject, perfectly symmetrical, deep focus from the cracked tiles at our feet to the house. The basin slopes away toward the deep end, its pale aqua tiles crazed with hairline fractures, stained rust-brown in tide rings, scattered with curled dead leaves and a toppled white sun lounger with one snapped leg. At the dead centre of the deep end stands a single figure, upright and composed, facing straight into the lens: a plain dark charcoal knitted ski mask covering the whole head, a thin white ring stitched around the eye hole on the wearer's left, and inside that ring at roughly the 2 o'clock position a small red triangle with softly rounded corners pointing downward. Dark plain jacket and trousers, black gloves, hands folded behind the back like a museum guide waiting for the group to catch up. Above the pool's coping the villa rises pale and shuttered, stucco flaking, an empty terrace and a dead potted palm, framed exactly in the middle. Flat, even white overcast sky, no shadows to speak of, soft diffuse light. Chalky, desaturated palette of bone white, faded turquoise, dust grey and leaf brown, with the small red triangle as the only saturated colour. Quiet, formal, absurdly calm. Negative prompt: water, people other than the figure, any visible skin, text, signage, letters, numbers, depth markings, logos.
